pages.title: Breeze Powder
pages.text: One rod, two powder, exactly as a Blaze Rod works. Powder fuels the Resonance Chamber: one is worth twenty batches, so a single rod goes a very long way.

pages.title: Wind Charges have moved
pages.text: Breeze Rods now have a second job, so the vanilla recipe that turned one rod into four Wind Charges would have made rods worth two very different things.$(br2)It is replaced by this one, mirroring the Fire Charge: $(thing)clay ball, gunpowder and Breeze Powder$() for three.
